story: Sea air, compact bends and an easy coastal reset south of the city. A 151 km loop that starts and ends near Tokyo, about 3 h 23 of riding. It goes by way of Yokohama, Kamakura, Hayama coastal road and Jogashima water stop.

scenicChapters.title: Hayama coastal road → Jogashima water stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 20 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.3%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
